title: Shell command executed through std::system in cpp — review required
description: std::system passes its string to the C library shell invocation. A value concatenated into that string is interpreted as shell syntax, so command substitution or separators run additional programs. The rule flags the call; whether the string is externally influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Use posix_spawn or CreateProcess with an argument vector and validate dynamic values.
limitation: Lexical: matches std::system and ::system calls; a spawn-based wrapper is out of scope.

tests.line: # verified: posix_spawn(&pid, "/usr/bin/convert", nullptr, nullptr, argv, environ);
